guidelines.detail: The records show omitted actions and a missing sequence flow, but the documented guideline FID-01 already says to model every distinct activity stated in the description, and FID-02/FLOW-01 and learned guideline LRN-040 cover preserving dependencies with sequence flows. No distinct additional guideline is supported by these records.

same as LRN-016 (The description provides the actions and decision scopes for the recorded label pairs, and the generated labels sometimes preserve details that the reference labels omit. The learned guideline already expresses the same principle of preserving stated meaning in concise labels.)

refines FLOW-01 (The missing-flow records show omitted transitions between steps and into or out of decision and synchronization gateways, while the description supports those transitions. This refines FLOW-01 by emphasizing preservation of the described order and branch continuation.)

same as LRN-016 (The label pairs show differences in how activities and decisions are expressed, while the descriptions provide specific actions and details that support faithful labels. This guideline is essentially the same as learned guideline LRN-016.)

same as LRN-034 (The description establishes that account setup and coming up with names can proceed concurrently, and the reference flows show parallel structure around the account-information activity. This is already essentially covered by learned guideline LRN-034. The extra payment-method activity does not represent the missing activity or flow addressed by this guideline.)

same as LRN-016 (The label pairs show details being added, omitted, or changed relative to the description. The description supports preserving those details in labels, and learned guideline LRN-016 already expresses this principle.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity, decision, or outcome and identifies its action or scope

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description specifies successive activities or a transition into or out of a decision or synchronization point: Connect the corresponding flow nodes with sequence flows so the modeled paths preserve the described order and branch continuation.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description specifies successive activities or a transition into or out of a decision or synchronization point

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that two or more actions occur at the same time, or that one action is independent of another after a shared prerequisite: Model the actions on separate branches from a parallel gateway. Use a parallel join only before a continuation that requires all those branches to finish.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says one activity can be done while another activity is in progress
